category: Application Library examples: LiveLink for SOLIDWORKS
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the LiveLink for SOLIDWORKS. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Electrical Heating in a Busbar Assembly [LiveLink for SOLIDWORKS example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the LiveLink for SOLIDWORKS (Tutorials, LiveLink Interface): Electrical Heating in a Busbar Assembly. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("LiveLink_for_SOLIDWORKS/Tutorials,_LiveLink_Interface/busbar_llsw") to solve it, comsol_example_info("busbar_llsw", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > LiveLink for SOLIDWORKS > Tutorials, LiveLink Interface > busbar llsw
tools.notes: Library path LiveLink_for_SOLIDWORKS/Tutorials,_LiveLink_Interface/busbar_llsw; model file 1.1 MB. Requires the module licence to open and solve.
